kashika: वारणार्थानां धातूनां प्रयोगे य ईप्सितोऽर्थः, तत् कारकमपादानसंज्ञं भवति। प्रवृत्तिविघातो वारणम्। यवेभ्यो गा वारयति। यवेभ्यो गा निवर्तयति। ईप्सित इति किम्? यवेभ्यो गा वारयति क्षेत्रे॥
kashikaEnglish: With verbs of prevention, the desired object from which one is blocked is apādāna.
englishFull:
With verbs of preventing, the desired object from which one is warded off is अपादान.

यवेभ्यो गां वारयति "he wards the cow off from the barley"
यवेभ्यो गां निवर्तयति "he turns the cow back from the barley"

**Why "desired object"?**
The place of prevention is locative:
गां वारयति क्षेत्रे "he wards off the cow in the field"
